# شَنَنْتِ (šananti) /ʃa.nan.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of شَنَّ (šanna)
# شُنِنْتُ (šunintu) /ʃu.nin.tu/: first-person singular past passive of شَنَّ (šanna)
